description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractMappingProcessor' in Java, which provides a common base for processing and mapping messages of generic types within a messaging system. It includes methods for processing messages, resolving conditions, handling mapping failures, and retrieving mappers from a registry.

classes.name: AbstractMappingProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides message processing capabilities, including condition resolution, mapper retrieval, and error handling, for message types in a messaging system.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Abstract method to process an incoming message of type I and produce a list of mapping outcomes.

methods.name: resolveConditions
methods.description: Resolves a collection of conditions using an ExpressionResolver, returning true if all conditions evaluate to true.

methods.name: buildMappingFailedException
methods.description: Constructs a MessageMappingFailedException with details about the failure scenario.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MessageMapper instances based on the provided PayloadMapping; defaults to a single default mapper if none are specified.
